about_the_game:
March across the Morris & Essex County suburbs and dart to the commuter town of Dover in classic electric equipment. New York awaits with the NJ TRANSIT® Morristown Line, ready for bustling rail operations in Train Sim World 6 – all aboard for Hoboken!

The Morristown line dates back to the lucrative 1830s, when New Jersey locals needed a connection to New York City. Born to carry people, the line accelerated in popularity among passengers, being extended to Dover by 1848. As time passed and companies merged, it became part of the many electrified lines into New York, and Hoboken terminal, and today is a frequent commuter line operated by NJ TRANSIT®.

One of the staples on the line is the Arrow III, also known as the Jersey Arrow. Original designs for this fleet of electric railcars date back as far as 1968 for the Pennsylvania Railroad, although the latest 3rd generation was built in 1977. Hoboken Division Arrow IIIs are denoted by a 25K sticker adorned on each cab end, meaning they are setup for 25kV use, as opposed to Newark Division’s 12kV electrification.

In Train Sim World 6, become an engineer or conductor aboard NJ TRANSIT® commuter services. Climb into the retro Arrow III EMU and depart from Hoboken, through the 1908 Bergen Tunnels, through Newark and Orange to ultimately reach Dover station. Or take the modern ALP-46 electric locomotive & MultiLevel cars on push/pull electric services bound for the Big Apple - rush under the river tunnels to New York Penn Station and stable trains in Sunnyside Yard.

Key Features


  • 40-mile route from New York Penn and Hoboken to Dover, New Jersey
  • 22 detailed stations, complete with authentic signage and audible passenger announcements
  • NJ TRANSIT® Arrow III 2-car EMU (25K variant)
  • NJ TRANSIT® ALP-46 & MultiLevel Cars & Control Car
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs
  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling
  • Audible on-board passenger announcements
  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center
  • A number of engaging Scenarios and an authentic timetable, including Conductor Mode
  • Journey Mode tying together Training, Scenarios and Timetabled Services
  • Additional timetable layers adding;
    • NJ TRANSIT® dual-mode traffic with the ALP-45DP (available separately)
    • AI Amtrak services along the shared NEC tracks (available separately)
  • Timetable gameplay can be influenced by random events
  • A selection of Route Tasks to complete
  • Explore the route and trains in Free Roam
  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 9.5 GB
